description: The contact form of the chat card that chat_with_agent opens: sends the name, email and optional message the user typed, after they ticked the consent box, to the person or business behind the agent, who can reply by email. It is app-only, so hosts keep it from the assistant. Agents whose owners don't take contact details refuse it.

consent.description: Whether the user ticked the consent box. Without it nothing is sent.

email.description: The email address the user typed.

message.description: The message the user typed, if any.

name.description: The name the user typed, if any.

name: leave_contact
title: Send contact details
